summary: Village page gives only 200+ sites and 4 lakes; aggregator-only hookups, dump, season and booking cleared; no rate anywhere (flag).
flags: NO PUBLISHED RATE: the village's page lists none; nothing else dated found. Only figure: WOSU 2015, ~$450/month. Phone 740-942-3213 confirmed by Google Maps (4.4/468); the village's page has 740-942-8844.

LONG-STAY LEAD, for AWH: imagery shows three packed lots of parked RVs around the ballpark. WOSU 2015 describes oilfield workers living there with no two-week cap, and an old RV Life review (2007) says 3 of 4 areas are permanent sites with one open field for weekenders. The village doesn't say it takes ordinary nights. Test 2 may apply.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (down): stored lakefront. Imagery puts the big RV lots on higher ground away from the lakes; only a few units near (about) the upper arm east of the park road, none clearly on the shore. No page claims lakefront sites; 'lakes' here are small reservoirs.
Note: dropped 'RV Life 2.5*/$', redundant with rating. PIN OK: in the camp area, between the ballpark and the upper lot.
